svg.title: Earth-orbiting satellite constellation
svg.desc: An original schematic of Earth surrounded by three circular orbital planes, each populated by four satellites. Colors distinguish the orbital planes, and satellites are phased differently between planes. Dashed arcs pass behind Earth. Some satellites are hidden by Earth. This is an illustrative arrangement, not a specific mission; satellite sizes and orbital altitudes are not to scale.

g.text: Illustrative circular orbits · Satellite sizes and orbital altitudes are not to scale
